notes.title: Third Crisis: Neon Nights - v0.1 Demo Release!
notes.content:
The demo for Third Crisis' prequel is out now! 💜


Dive into a cyberpunk metropolis as the mercenary, Zoey Madison. Find a way to navigate the seductive and corrupt Neon City. Choose who to trust, what to desire, and how far you'll go. Are you in it for the pleasure? Or will you stay pure?‎


Play the demo today ♡
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"]

Zoey's latest contract takes her to the Glowing Hole: a brothel in the Red Light District of Neon City. There are three distinct ways for Zoey to accomplish her task.



Plus... an especially perverted way to end it. 👀



Enjoy experiencing them all!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/dde3cbcd7710152b736a70447ded8f074dd8ba48.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/f300046add56758501126f3b107996a18d09e5da.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/793d826ac57cbd796d855499eb432424110f81fd.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/6f10a4004896b5bace74115fac491d5dbbf6cdeb.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/85b91f0ede9ad09e01e71ba7c3cd31957a17ee9f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"]

We've put our hearts and souls into this release, utilizing everything we've learned from Third Crisis to completely blow our previous game out of the water. From animated overworld characters to fully voice-acted dialogue, this is truly an evolution of what you loved from Third Crisis and more.



We hope you enjoy this demo and stick around to see what the game looks like in the years to come!


Play the demo today ♡
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400350/Third_Crisis_Neon_Nights/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/207e70338c9b44c39f2654b173f8eee1b167dba5.png"]

Lastly, we are actively developing the game, so make sure to hop onto our Discord if you want to follow our progress or chat with us!

Your feedback and support will help shape the ultimate cyberlust experience.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567870/813f5c501e5e9155eba35e2e48f4af9ece689fd7.png"]

 
With Love,Anduo Games ♡

notes.title: Third Crisis - Early Access Price - Last Chance
notes.content:
Gamers, we are here to announce a price change with Third Crisis hitting 1.0! 

We had planned to announce this change back during the launch, but ended up not doing so yet because our team was busy fixing, as well as adjusting, any reported bugs, kinks or other feedback found and shared by all of YOU!

In case you want to ever report anything else - feel free to do so through our Steam discussion or our official Discord server! We read all of your messages, so don’t be a stranger!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36989033/2676a5f55e76f7ee9715ddf97c5db60efe0555ea.png

What to expect?
 The price of Third Crisis on Steam will change from $19.99 USD to $24.99 USD exactly 1 month from today’s post, so you have time to adjust! (July 10th, 2024)

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36989033/18cabc1980ea7e7058257eaececee29fef51cc24.png


Why is the price being adjusted?
After seven years of overall development, and three years in Early Access on Steam, the amount of content on offer has increased significantly. Due to this, we’ll be increasing the price to match what we believe is the new value of the game. You can see this content trend visualised via the scientific graph below:

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36989033/1f93c449dc397ad5235d9f414efb2d79891c3efa.png

With love,
Anduo Games Team


The price will change to $24.99 USD on July 10th 2024!

notes.title: The Combat Update is Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36989033/9b6bbe582798a7a45aea1a40538698bdacec3ac6.png

 Added the ability to pan the camera around when not using an ability during combat.
        Right-click and drag to pan.
        Two fingers and drag on touch.

This change gives more situational awareness so more informed decisions can be made.

 Added new overhaul to how energy is handled in combat.
        Moving no longer takes energy (speed still determines how far you can move).
        Only one energy will recharge per turn (instead of all of it).
        Jenna’s energy is now 2 (from 3).

This should give party members the same aggression that only Jenna used to have.

 Added additional content to one of the new badgeless scenes.
 Added a new pinup featuring Jenna and PixieWillow.
 Added new Jewel CGs to replace the placeholder ones for her introduction scene.
 Fixed gigabrain not displaying properly.
 Fixed five broken animations due to engine update (thanks Unity).
 Fixed 40+ dialogue typos.
 Fixed an issue where some party members wouldn’t save their recognized state.

notes.title: Third Crisis - Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Vilsa here!

Third Crisis has been released to early access on Steam! It's now available for $19.99 USD! There is also a free demo that you can try out before buying the game to see if it's something you'll like.

This is only the beginning of the road to completion, and we're so excited to bring you all along on the ride. You'll be hearing from us with monthly releases and you can chime in back at us with feedback that we always do our best to read up on.

Two more things to go over while I've got your attention!

Easter Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989033/b42bd201e08eb3030fefd54d6cda4204eb33d77c.png
We've left the Easter event running for all of you to enjoy before May begins! We'll be taking it down on May 1st, so go grab that bunny suit while you still can!

Patchnotes
Without further ado, let's get right into what this release brings! If you're brand new to the game, you won't have to pay as much attention to this since everything will be new anyways, but we've got patch notes for returning players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989033/ca9baeea8f404e070a98e12584839b596620f492.png

Follow the instructions to unlock each one in the gallery.

Continue the Peitho storyline after the townhall storyline as normal.

Complete the main storyline up to the tunnels sequence, then talk to Rida.

Complete the main storyline up to the tunnels sequence, then choose Rida to sleep with.

View the scene from the Gallery.

Buy the outfit and its pasties from the Gear Shop.
